MANUU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for MANUU Recruitment 2026 is Assistant Professor (Contractual). This walk-in drive offers a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) post in MANUU Recruitment 2026. Interested candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) Recruitment 2026 is 03 September 2026. Candidates must report on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Assistant Professor (Contractual) in MANUU?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in Interior Design / Interior Architecture or allied disciplines with at least 55% marks OR a Bachelor's Degree with at least 55% marks and five years relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) Recruitment 2026. Candidates can attend the interview free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Assistant Professor (Contractual) at MANUU?
faq.answer: The salary for Assistant Professor (Contractual) at MANUU will not exceed 50000 per month. Detailed salary information can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) will be conducted in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. The exact venue details will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the MANUU Assistant Professor (Contractual) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. Refer to the official notification for a complete list of required documents.
